python3 << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Extracted Text"

# Header row
ws["A1"] = "Source"
ws["B1"] = "Extracted Text"
header_font = Font(bold=True, size=12)
ws["A1"].font = header_font
ws["B1"].font = header_font

# Data rows
ws["A2"] = "Title"
ws["B2"] = "Employee Handbook"

ws["A3"] = "Content"
ws["B3"] = "Welcome to the company. This handbook outlines our policies."

# Adjust column widths
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 60

# Alignment
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=3, max_col=2):
    for cell in row:
        cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="center")

output_path = "/workspace/handbook_extracted.xlsx"
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Excel file saved to: {output_path}")
EOF
